event.title: US Secret Service Aware of Iranian Threat to Barron Trump
event.canonical_title: US Secret Service Aware of Iranian Threat to Barron Trump
event.summary: The US Secret Service has confirmed its awareness of a threat to Barron Trump, the son of Donald Trump, stemming from a video broadcast by Iranian state media. The video, which is linked to the Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps, reportedly includes a $10 million bounty on Barron Trump's life and claims that his movements are being monitored.

The agency has confirmed its awareness of a threat against Barron Trump, although details regarding the nature of the misconduct have not been disclosed.

event_overview.title: About US Secret Service Aware of Iranian Threat to Barron Trump
event_overview.subject: US Secret Service Aware of Iranian Threat to Barron Trump
event_overview.summary: The event concerns a video aired by Iranian state media that appeared to threaten Barron Trump, the son of President Donald Trump, and the U.S. Secret Service's acknowledgment that it was aware of the material. The agency said it investigates anything perceived as a threat to a protectee, while declining to discuss protective-intelligence measures for operational-security reasons.

facts.label: Nature of the material
facts.value: The reported video was aired by Iranian state media and appeared to threaten Barron Trump; public reporting described it as showing places he is known to spend time and referring to a monetary reward.

facts.label: Broader U.S. context
facts.value: This incident arose against a background of Justice Department cases alleging Iran-linked efforts to target U.S. officials and citizens, including a 2024 complaint alleging a thwarted murder-for-hire plot against a politician or U.S. government official; allegations in a complaint are not findings of guilt.

event_overview.scope_note: The selected Muninn timeline covers the August 26, 2026 developments involving the Secret Service and related internal-misconduct reporting, not every prior Iran-related threat, prosecution, or protective-security action.
